thread:
leo: Quick sync  PR #822 adds a troubleshooting appendix for 429s, timeouts, and context-eviction but some SDK examples target pre-0.10 names. Need a short sweep.
tess: Where are the stale lines? I can update snippets and add a compact migration callout.
leo: The JS snippet uses `client.opts({max_inflight: 20, context_budget: 2048})` which in SDK 0.10 should be `concurrency_limit` and `window_tokens`. Also we call out `retryOn429: true` as a user flag; runtime fallbacks now manage retries and tiered fallback automatically.
nina: I'll prepare a tiny patch to rename parameters and add a "What changed in 0.10" blurb.
rai: Can we include a one-paragraph guidance on diagnosing injected 429s after upgrade? Keep it prescriptive: check concurrency_limit, inspect prefix/KV cache hit rates, and fallback counts in the Console.
craig: Add a short reproducible command for staging to help support teams: `wrk -t12 -c200 -d30s https://staging.api.redwood/v1/chat` and note to run from the same AZ. Also mention that increasing batch_window lowers CPU cost but may amplify p99 under tail-heavy requests.
tess: Draft diff I'll land:```diff
- client.opts({max_inflight: 20, context_budget: 2048, retryOn429: true})
+ client.opts({concurrency_limit: 20, window_tokens: 2048})
```
leo: Nice. Also add a tiny mocked example in examples/integration/mock-backpressure that runs the snippet against our local dev server; wire it into the docs CI so examples fail the PR if the API drifts.
doc-bot: docs-qa checklist added to PR #822: examples-run, lint-samples, migration-callout, staging-repro-snippet
nina: I'll draft the migration copy and a short "If 429s rise after upgrading" checklist with three actions: reduce concurrency_limit, enable prefix/KV caching, add client-side exponential backoff with jitter.
rai: Suggest a short diagnostics query we can paste for Support: `SELECT count(*) FROM fallback_events WHERE tenant_id = ? AND reason = 'overload' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'`. Keeps triage fast.
craig: Timeline: aim to merge by Tue AM. Tess, can you slot a 5-min demo in Tues docs sync to show the staging repro and the new example harness?
tess: Yes. I'll also call out backport to the 0.9 troubleshooting page after merge so older customers see the migration notes.
leo: Thank you. After merge, create a tiny follow-up issue to add a unit test that lints examples against the published SDK type definitions each CI run.
doc-bot: follow-up and backport issues queued post-merge. :white_check_mark:
